review:
Johnny Cash goes underground as a gold digger, on a 5x3, 25-line grid with free spins, wilds and a Gold Respin.

Six or more coins start the bonus, where only coins worth 1x to 20x can land. You get six respins, Plus Spin symbols add more, and 15 coins wins the jackpot of up to 5,000x. Very high volatility, a 5,624x max and 96.14% RTP. Free spins roughly once every 182 spins.
pros: Second route to big wins via respins or jackpots
Full game playable in the official free demo
cons: Very high volatility – long dry spells are normal
Bonus buy is costly and banned in some markets (e.g. Great Britain)
Short-session results can differ widely from the RTP
